Scenario: Draw-queue Kafka outage with durable Outbox notification and consumer recovery

Environment.JavaVersion:
java version "17.0.12" 2024-07-16 LTS
Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 17.0.12+8-LTS-286)
Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 17.0.12+8-LTS-286, mixed mode, sharing)

FaultInjection.Recovery: Broker restarted; DrawQueued was confirmed in Kafka before a fresh consumer group started; queue completed without periodic scan fallback

Note: One request, one consumer process and one disposable broker. Proves durable enqueue/notification and recovery; not consumer rebalance, multi-broker HA or capacity.
